strategyFamily: causal bidirectional cross-venue perpetual funding-spread carry
externalHypothesis: Lau (2026) reports that Hyperliquid funding structurally exceeded Binance/Bybit funding and that a static cross-venue perp spread remained significant into 2026. Trial 26 is an independent implementation with conservative costs, explicit venue-isolated margin accounting, a frozen static benchmark, and a causal bidirectional extension. No Trial 26 market rows were queried before this manifest was committed.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final sources may be acquired only after the frozen development gate passes.

benchmark.name: fixed_hyperliquid_premium
benchmark.position: always long Binance perp and short equal coin units of Hyperliquid perp
benchmark.purpose: direct static cross-venue comparator to the published funding-spread idea

candidate.name: causal_bidirectional_spread
candidate.decisionRule: After 90 complete prior 8h spread observations, hold long Binance/short Hyperliquid if the trailing mean Hyperliquid-minus-Binance funding spread is positive; hold short Binance/long Hyperliquid if it is negative. The current boundary is excluded from the decision. Change direction only when the trailing mean sign changes; a sign change closes and reopens both legs at full modeled costs.
candidate.zeroRule: If the trailing mean is exactly zero, retain the prior direction; before first nonzero signal remain in cash.

fundingAlignment.aggregation: Sum Hyperliquid hourly funding observations in each Binance 8h interval; reject an interval unless exactly eight hourly observations are present.
fundingAlignment.decisionCausality: At boundary t, decisions use completed funding intervals ending strictly before t. Funding for the interval ending at t accrues to the position that was held during that interval before any direction change.

costModel.costApplication: Each leg pays fee plus slippage on every open and close. Costs are deliberately conservative and symmetric rather than exchange-tier optimized.

marginModel.liquidationRule: Fail immediately if either venue collateral plus that venue cumulative mark-to-market and funding PnL falls below 5% of its current leg notional.
marginModel.stressRule: At every held boundary require each venue independently to survive an instantaneous adverse 20% mark move before hedge offset elsewhere.

literatureComparison.rule: Report comparison but do not alter Trial 26 parameters after seeing results.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 26 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, gate, leverage, cost, alignment rule, or direction rule may change under Trial 26.
